content.value: A bacteria culture is known to grow at a rate proportional to the amount <sub>present.</sub> After one hour, I 000 stands of the bacteria are observed in the culture and after four hours 3000 stands. Obtain an expression for the approximate number of stands of the bacteria <sub>present</sub> in the culture at any time t and hence find the approximate number of stands of the bacteria originally in the culture.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2023
